name: create-contact-import
description: Bulk-import contacts from a CSV file into Resend. The import is processed asynchronously: this returns an import ID immediately, then use get-contact-import to poll its status and counts. Provide the CSV as raw text via `content`. Max file size 100MB.

filename.description: Name for the uploaded file. Defaults to "contacts.csv".

columnMap.description: Maps contact fields to CSV header names. When omitted, headers are matched case-sensitively to "email", "first_name", and "last_name".

email.description: CSV header name that contains email addresses.

firstName.description: CSV header name that contains first names.

lastName.description: CSV header name that contains last names.

unsubscribed.description: CSV header name that contains the unsubscribed flag.

properties.description: Maps custom property keys to CSV columns (e.g. { "company_name": { "column": "Company" } }).

column.description: CSV header name to map to this property.

onConflict.description: How to handle contacts that already exist: "upsert" updates them, "skip" leaves them unchanged. Defaults to "upsert".

segmentIds.description: Array of segment IDs to assign the imported contacts to.

topics.description: Topic subscription configurations applied to the imported contacts.
